slug.description: Unique bundle slug (matches its folder name).

notice.description: Legal notice shown with the bundle. REQUIRED when "game" is set: a pack that targets a third-party game must disclaim any affiliation with its publisher (e.g. 'Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.'). Enforced by scripts/validate.js.

slug.description: Reserved Hou.la slot. ix_slot_01..99. A slot is a PLACE, not a price: since 2026-09-08 the price is declared per slot via coinCost, so several distinct gifts may share the same price. Two digits only — ix_slot_100 is rejected.

coinCost.description: Price in coins paid by the viewer. Closed ladder, NOT free-form: the amount converts 1:1 into stars and then into a real payable liability. Omit to keep the reserved slot's historical price.

label.description: Short human-readable summary of what the gift DOES (e.g. 'Gives the player a diamond'), shown in the Studio picker tooltip + to viewers. Author-written; English by convention — the platform does not translate it. Distinct from effect.command (the executable, connector-side).

image.description: Original artwork under this bundle's assets/ folder.

type.description: shell is intentionally NOT allowed in community bundles.
